newsitem.title: USA: Megalith unit in Far East joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Megalith unit in Far East joint venture.

text.p: Megalith Corp unit Esco Elevator Corp said it has entered into a joint venture with a major Pacific Rim building contractor, Jon C.K. Tse, to sell elevators and escalators in South China, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines and other Pacific Rim nations.

It said the joint venture, 54 percent owned by Esco, is expected to produce revenues of over $150 million in the next three years and that its production capabilities are being ramped up rapidly so it can ship more than $150 million in elevators and elevator parts over the next three years.

Under terms of the agreement, the company said that 30 percent of the sales price will be wired to Esco at the time purchase orders are placed. It said 60 percent, payable on shipping, will be guaranteed by an irrevocable bank letter of credit, and the balance paid by wire transfer 12 months after shipment.

In addition to the construction of buildings in many Pacific Rim nations, Esco's joint venture partner, has constructed 10 commercial buildings of 30 stories or more in Hong Kong over the past several years.
